mechanics.name: Rookie Spirit
mechanics.currentEffect: While repairing Generators, succeed at 5/4/3 Good or Great Skill Checks to activate Rookie Spirit for the remainder of the Trial. It reveals the Auras of any regressing Generators until they stop regressing by any means.
activation: While repairing Generators, succeed at 5/4/3 Good or Great Skill Checks.
Ends/deactivates when: Each Generator Aura stops being revealed when that Generator stops regressing by any means.
mechanics.patchNote: Latest live balance change (unknown): No material live balance change could be verified from available patch history.
mechanics.plainEnglishSummary: After enough successful Generator Skill Checks, you see regressing Generator Auras for the rest of the Trial.
duration: Perk activates for the remainder of the Trial; each Aura reveal lasts while that Generator is regressing.
mechanics.tokenOrStackBehavior: Successful Good or Great Repair Skill Checks count toward the 5/4/3 activation requirement.
mechanics.oncePerTrialOrOtherLimits: Activates for the remainder of the Trial after meeting the Skill Check requirement.

editorial.summary: After landing three basic generator Skill Checks at Tier III, permanently reveal every generator that is currently regressing.
useCases: Identify which generators the Killer has recently kicked or otherwise forced into regression.
Return to a threatened generator before too much progress is lost.
Use regression Auras as indirect information about where the Killer has been applying pressure.
counters: Requires three generator Skill Checks before activation.
Does not show the Killer or tell you how much progress the generator has.
Some regression sources or game states may create information that is obvious anyway.
pros: Permanent activation after the initial setup.
Can protect team generator progress indirectly.
Very easy to read once active.
cons: Setup timing depends on Skill Check RNG.
analysis: Rookie Spirit takes this position because seeing regressing generators can help the team identify objectives that are quietly losing progress, especially in Solo Q where nobody may call out the kick.

Once activated, the perk stays active for the rest of the Trial. The problem is getting the three repair Skill Checks early enough for the information to matter. A generator can sometimes be nearly finished before the perk has even armed.
The Auras provide indirect Killer information as well. A newly regressing generator often tells you where the Killer just spent time, though the perk does not show their current direction.
Rookie Spirit remains low C because Déjà Vu, Alert, Poised, and other objective tools provide more actionable information with fewer setup quirks.
editorial.verdict: A reasonable regression monitor that arrives after three Skill Checks. Rookie Spirit can save unnoticed generator progress, but stronger information perks answer bigger questions.
